scope: Ordinary native reverse traffic and solid observation; no new movement controller or whole-HBQ parity claim.
implementation: Following and solid observers project the actual rear hull in unit body metres for ordinary native backing; rear stand-off 2m, forward 6m unchanged. Reverse yields crossing traffic from both sides and cannot delegate forward spacing.

Physical longitudinal motion selects observation direction. Exact owner, seat, route and normalized native-task observation retains rear sensing during its own cap stop. New forward motion, native forward evidence or changed context ends retention; this is not native gear acknowledgement or movement authority.

A qualified current native forward path of 0.5 to under 3m supplies direction-only evidence. Its five-field packet cannot supply curvature/support; both curvature consumers require the original four-field packet. Unusable stopped path timestamps remain unconsumed.
Direction observation publishes only after cap acknowledgement and retires with the owned cap. Scheduled callers recheck task snapshots. Existing independent-command admission remains unchanged.
Rear observation suppresses new forward-only gate/pass/corridor/bypass/recovery admission. Pedestrian intent uses rear direction. No new worker, timer, setting or movement writer.
boundedCost: Existing constrained one-second observation cadence is used during backing. No extra query or ray per observation; aggregate work may increase and runtime cost is unmeasured.
